about_the_game:
The Game where YOU'RE the Star !

Starbump is a wild party platformer where you bounce, bump, and battle peers in colorful worlds.
It plays just like your favorite 3D platformer classics- if you tossed in friends, chaos, and a whole lot of bumping.

Take control of the Gummies : agile, jelly-like star creatures

...And compete with friends in fast-paced battles across the galaxy!

Currently with four announced game modes, each offering a distinct experience:

Parkour

Race for glory! Compete to reach the final platform first!

You can knock opponents aside, but they’ll bounce back quickly! so choose your battles wisely!

Each run features randomly generated parkour chunks, keeping every race fresh. 

If you fall, you’ll respawn at the last life-platform you touched, don’t skip them!

The round ends once a player claims the final platform and finishes the race for everyone!

Arena 

A relentless cozy-brawl ! Eject your opponent!

Knock your opponents out of the stage! Each hit makes them stay unconscious longer, giving others more chances

to toss them out. 

Grab wacky weapons like boxing gloves, soda cans, boom-boom guns, or sticky bombs to spice things up.

With many unique arenas each with its own special twist, the fight quickly turns into a chaotic, hilarious battlefield.

In the end, it’s less about winning and more about how spectacularly you send your friends flying! 

only the most cunning (and the most shamelessly lucky) will survive this madness!

Rocketball

Rock that gummy! Spin at the right time!

In this mode, rockets are flying everywhere and your only hope is to swat them back with a perfectly timed magic spin! Each time someone deflects the rocket, it speeds up, bouncing around faster and faster until chaos takes over.

Keep your cool, trust your reflexes, and pray you’re not the gummy who blinks first… because, as always, the last gummy standing takes the win!

Tag

Crown Chase! Keep the crown as long as you can!

Your mission is simple: climb to the top and snatch the crown! But don’t expect an easy ride… everyone else is scrambling, pushing, and shoving to reach it too!

Once you’ve got it, your score starts climbing… but one touch from another player and it’s stolen right off your head. 

The gameplay quickly turns into a wild chase full of betrayals, last-second steals, and nonstop shouting at your friends! (and honestly, that’s exactly the point.)

Future new modes will expand on these mechanics, adding variety and replayability.

Features

Starbump is all about fun, friendship, and a little bit of rivalry. Grab your controller, gather your pals, and get ready to turn every match into a story you’ll still be laughing about tomorrow

Complete moveset, nice skillcurve

Cool maps and events



Cool weapons


Schedule

We plan on adding up to 7 game modes in the early access release, like a race mode, touchdown, and others. Also a story adventure introduction will be available in coop or solo. And of course always adding skins and items

The Starbump universe is ever expanding, two new worlds, fire and ice will be added for early access and more later in free updates. 

We are planning this early access release for Q1 2026, with a public demo just before, around February of this next year.

After that we will be working on the final release for what we hope less than a year, with online support and complete adventure mode. 

Console porting and new online specific game modes are in our objectives but still far.

Our philosophy

 As two indie developers, we believe in real craft, not shortcuts. Everything in our game is built by hand, without AI.
We also plan on having no paid update, no in-game purchase, no time-limited items, everything is in the game you paid once, in the way of old school gaming practices.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-Bit)
  • Processor: i5-3570K 3.4 GHz 4 Core
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 (2GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Starbump combines fast-paced action, Third Person platforming and competitive modes in vibrants worlds. It’s designed for party nights where you and your friends battle it out for hours, packed into colorful arenas and quick-fire game modes. It's a pure cozy brawl !
